stem.text: A student was asked to estimate the concentration of glucose in a solution using the Benedict’s test. The student was provided with a $1.0\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ glucose solution and was told to make a $0.6\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ solution by proportional dilution.
Which row shows the correct volumes of both $1.0\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ glucose solution and distilled water needed to make the $0.6\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ solution?
